text:
anya: FYI hitting a weird client-side fairness issue in sampleapp. Bursts from prefetch worker hog the window, other user requests get 429s even though account quota not saturated. Logs attached.

anya: ```
[2026-03-20T15:02:11Z] POST /v1/generate 429 {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","quota_remaining":1200}
[2026-03-20T15:02:11Z] inflight: 64 window: 128 prefetch-worker=64 user-requests=0
```

mike: repro steps?

anya: run sampleapp with prefetch=true and window_size=128, concurrency=64. Code:

anya: ```js
// client config
client.init({window: 128, concurrency: 64, prefetch: true})
```

sophie: sounds like head-of-line blocking in our client backpressure. Prefetch loop holds all slots, no fairness.

raul: also check server-side cursor TTL — if prefetch misses KV cache, latency spikes -> 429s bubble.

anya: increased client cap to 80 and still saw long tail; turning off prefetch removes the 429s.

sophie: short-term: add weighted fairness to the client: reserve N slots for interactive requests. Pseudoconfig:

sophie: ```
client.init({
  concurrency: 64,
  reserve_for_interactive: 8,
  prefetch_window: 32,
  jitter_ms: 50
})
```

mike: do all SDKs support reserve_for_interactive?

anya: currently only JS and Go have it. Py's retry wrapper auto-retries on 429, hiding the symptom and causing duplicate writes for some customers.

anya: example:

anya: ```py
# python sdk default
resp = client.generate(..., max_retries=3)  # retries on 429 by default
```

mike: that's bad. We should not retry by default for idempotent vs non-idempotent.

sophie: agree. Proposal: make Py opt-in for 429 retry and add honor-server-429 flag to clients so server hints can be used.

eng-bot: deploy/canary sampleapp-prefetch-fairness patch queued (#4598)

anya: mitigation for customers: set env var SAMPLEAPP_PREFETCH=false or client.set('reserve_for_interactive',8)

raul: add doc note in onboarding (prefetch caveats) + sampleapp change.

mike: I'll own the Py retry change. Sophie can do JS/Go fairness patch. Anya can update sampleapp and add test repro.

anya: ack. Will open PRs and link here.

anya: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/612
mike: Py issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/issues/228
sophie: JS PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/845

anya: TL;DR: prefetch+large window can starve interactive requests. Short-term: reserve slots; medium-term: SDK parity + retry semantics.
